proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F _ _ _ _ _ D T hD
  have hdr : DenseRange (D.subtypeL : D →L[𝕜] E) := by
    simpa [DenseRange] using hD
  have hie : IsUniformInducing (D.subtypeL : D →L[𝕜] E) := D.subtypeₗᵢ.isometry.isUniformInducing
  constructor
  · refine ⟨T.extend D.subtypeL, fun x => ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact T.extend_eq (e := D.subtypeL) hdr hie x
    · apply le_antisymm
      · have := T.opNorm_extend_le (e := D.subtypeL) (N := 1) hdr (fun x => by simp)
        simpa using this
      · refine T.opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg _) fun x => ?_
        rw [← T.extend_eq (e := D.subtypeL) hdr hie x]
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans_eq (by simp)
  · intro S₁ S₂ h₁ h₂
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    refine fun x => (hdr.equalizer S₁.continuous S₂.continuous ?_ |> congrFun <| x)
    funext y
    simp [h₁ y, h₂ y]
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace F] (D : Submodule 𝕜 E) (T : D →L[𝕜] F), Dense (D : Set E) → (∃ S : E →L[𝕜] F, (∀ x : D, S x = T x) ∧ ‖S‖ = ‖T‖) ∧ ∀ S₁ S₂ : E →L[𝕜] F, (∀ x : D, S₁ x = T x) → (∀ x : D, S₂ x = T x) → S₁ = S₂
